risks.title: Dependence on Key Customers
risks.summary: Loss or reduction of business with a major customer could significantly impact revenues.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the context of concentrated sales among a few major customers. Significant exposure to leading airlines and defense customers represents a major risk. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Intense Technological Competition
risks.summary: Competitive pressure requires constant innovation to maintain market share.
risks.score_rationale: Highly positioned in the 10-K with mention of major competitors (Honeywell, RTX, etc.) and risk of customers becoming competitors. Language emphasizes innovation as a critical differentiator. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Mandatory Regulatory Certifications
risks.summary: Lack of certification may prevent product sales in critical markets.
risks.score_rationale: Presented as an entry barrier but also a major operational risk in aerospace and industrial sectors. Strong language highlights safety and regulatory compliance requirements. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cyberattacks or IT Intrusions
risks.summary: A major cyberattack could disrupt operations, compromise data, or damage reputation.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited in forward-looking statements as potentially impacting financial condition, results, and reputation. Strong language and existential risk for an IT/industrial company. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risks Related to International Operations
risks.summary: Trade, tariff, or geopolitical tensions can affect supply chain and costs.
risks.score_rationale: Repeated mention of risks related to tariffs, global supply chain, and foreign markets. Explicit concern regarding evolving U.S.-China trade policy and its impact on the industrial segment. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on Raw Material Suppliers
risks.summary: Unavailability or rising prices of raw materials may impact margin and production.
risks.score_rationale: Cited in forward-looking statements as a supply risk. Moderate language, but inflationary context and tight supply chains reinforce its relevance. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Acquisition Integration
risks.summary: Failure to integrate an acquisition may result in additional costs and operational disruptions.
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned in forward-looking statements as a risk that could affect results. Preventive but serious language, typical of major strategic risks. (default score, to be refined)
